claims.assertion: Anéeka describes lurkers as widespread, carnivorous insectoids; some reach three metres, reproduce through hosts, and can devastate local fauna before hibernating.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She knows them from computer data, not firsthand encounters.

claims.assertion: She says lurkers are carbon-silicon hybrids, with silicon concentrated in the exoskeleton and teeth.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She describes this as her current understanding.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says medical pods safely treat interdimensional parasites, though some regeneration procedures cannot be interrupted midway.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She gives lost-limb restoration as an example.
